name: H5b - Numerical Superiority: 3v1 Infantry Engagement
hypothesis: H5: Three InfantrySquads vs one should produce >80% win rate and the lone defender should rarely survive beyond the initial contact.
description: Three InfantrySquads vs one InfantrySquad on an open 20x20 field. This sub-variant tests whether the advantage scales beyond 2v1.
expected_observations: Blue should win >85% of engagements. Red should rarely eliminate more than one Blue unit before falling.
